subject: Welcome bundle packaging carveout & conversion to Dedicated
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina@glowai.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome bundle packaging question

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week — excited about GlowAI joining the accelerator cohort. Before we finalize the onboarding docs, a couple of packaging questions from procurement and our CFO: 

- The welcome bundle shows 100k free tokens + a $5k stipend. Can those credits be applied toward a Dedicated deployment (we'll need dedicated for PII workloads)?
- Is there any flexibility to let us roll a portion of the stipend into professional services (onboarding hours) or convert credits to a 6-month usage credit we can deploy as needed?

Procurement is asking for a short note that we can share with finance to justify the spend and whether the credits appear on an invoice or remain off-invoice.

I've attached our standard onboarding checklist (GlowAI_Welcome_Package.pdf). If conversion is a no-go by policy, please let us know options (discount, one-time conversion fee, extended expiry).

Cheers,
Lina Gomez
Head of Operations — GlowAI
lina@glowai.co
Attachment: GlowAI_Welcome_Package.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@glowai.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome bundle packaging question

Hi Lina — great to hear and congrats on joining the cohort. Quick answers and proposed path: 

Short answer: the standard welcome bundle is normally not convertible to Dedicated credits because of capacity allocation and reserved throughput implications. That said, we have a partner carveout process we can use for accelerator participants where we grant a one-off conversion or apply stipend toward onboarding/PS with approvals from Finance + Sales Ops.

Proposed mutual action plan (if you want to proceed):
- You: confirm PO timeline + procurement contact (we need PO or DocuSign to start contractual change)
- Us (Redwood): draft a one-page addendum that either
  * converts up to 50% of the free-token allotment to a Dedicated credit pool (subject to a $2.5k conversion fee), or
  * allows stipend ($5k) to be used for up to 20 hours of onboarding PS (we invoice PS)
- Finance/legal review: 48–72 hours for internal approval
- Execute addendum and schedule onboarding (target start within 7 days of sign)

If you prefer a discount instead of conversion, we can offer a one-time 12% discount on first two months of Dedicated committed capacity (for a minimum 3-month commit).

I've attached the SOW template and a draft welcome addendum outline for your review (RDWD_SOW_Template.docx). Ben/Marissa — looping you in to confirm the conversion fee and whether we can extend expiry to 6 months for cohort partners.

Also: can you share the procurement contact (email) to route invoicing and a preferred billing cadence?

Best,
Priyom Das
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
Attachments: RDWD_SOW_Template.docx, GlowAI_Welcome_Package.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome bundle packaging question

Thanks for the context — quick commercial proposal below. I'm fine to approve an exception for accelerator partners with these guardrails: 

- Conversion option: up to 50% of free tokens converted to a Dedicated credit (we would burn the remaining free tokens for hosted usage). Conversion carries a one-time operational/seat reconfiguration fee of $2,500 (covers capacity reservation and reserved GPU allocation).
- Stipend flexibility: allow up to 100% of the $5k stipend to be applied to PS (onboarding consulting); Redwood invoices PS services and the stipend offsets that invoice. Any unused stipend is not refundable.
- Expiry: converted Dedicated credits valid for 6 months from execution (extendable once, subject to review).
- Discount alternative: if GlowAI prefers, grant 15% off committed Dedicated rate for first 3 months (requires 3-month minimum commit).

If that sounds reasonable I'll ask Legal for a short addendum (1 page) and we can get Marissa to sign off on the commercial terms. Also flagging a billing note: if procurement needs invoice-based credits instead of off-invoice credits, we can issue a zero-dollar invoice that documents the credit allocation for their GL — ops will need the PO to route.

Ben
Director, GTM Partnerships — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Lina Gomez <lina@glowai.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@glowai.co, mark.hsu@glowai.co
Date: 2027-04-19 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome bundle packaging question

Thanks — this is helpful and close to what we hoped for. Two quick asks before we confirm: 

1) DocuSign: procurement prefers a DocuSign addendum we can sign today. Can you route the 1-page addendum to docusign and include the following line: 
   "Converted credits will be applied to the customer's Dedicated pool and documented on invoice for accounting purposes; converted credits are non-refundable."

2) Invoicing: please send invoices (and any zero-dollar credit documentation) to accounts@glowai.co. Our procurement contact is Elena Park (elena@glowai.co) and our CFO Mark Hsu (mark.hsu@glowai.co) is looped. We aim to sign by EOD tomorrow if legal is quick.

If you can confirm the $2,500 one-time conversion fee and that the PS stipend option is enabled, we'll proceed. Also — we'll need an itemized SOW for the onboarding hours if we go that route (20 hours).

On the quoted text from your note: 
> Conversion option: up to 50% of free tokens converted to a Dedicated credit (we would burn the remaining free tokens for hosted usage).

We'd like that reflected in the addendum exactly so our auditors see the token disposition.

Best,
Lina
Head of Operations — GlowAI
Attachment requested: itemized SOW (please send RDWD_SOW_Template.docx filled)
